ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white across central lobe regions with low-intensity black margins along the trailing edge and median notch; estimated 70:30 ratio of light to dark pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency micro-serrations along the trailing edge, with increased amplitude and irregularity on the outer lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex trajectory with a pronounced upward curvature, terminating in sharp, slightly recurved lateral tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular textural accumulation and probable tissue loss on the far left lateral tip; extensive parallel rake marks visible across both ventral surfaces.
